T22, new capability: we have the PS3 debug ELF with DWARF and full demangled names at D:\Games\acbf_ps3_gold\scimitar_final.elf (0.52 GB), plus bf-coop\logs\ps3_pubnames.txt (38 MB, 200k+ names) and bf-coop\logs\dwarf\. ops\tools\ps3_query.py and ps3_structs.py query it. This supersedes inferring from bit masks.
Your next task: produce a PS3->PC symbol map for the functions that matter to co-op: Entity::GetComponentByType, the component add/grow path, AbstractEntityAI, PlayerPerceptionMonitor / IsEnemyOfThePlayer, Faction/CharacterFactionChangedEvent, the entity factory (BuildEntityWithSelector and friends), SetGlobalMatrixInternal, and the CharacterController filter setter. Method: take the PS3 name, find its address in ps3_pubnames.txt, decompile the PS3 function to get its shape/string refs, then find the PC function with matching shape/strings and confirm by decompiling the PC side. Deliver ops/RE-PS3-MAP.md with name / PS3 addr / PC addr / how confirmed / confidence. Do not guess a PC address: mark unconfirmed ones clearly.
